map.螺旋桨飞机航程公式。: The range formula for propeller aircraft.
map.航程随升阻比对数增长。: Range grows logarithmically with the lift-to-drag ratio.
map.涡轮喷气/涡扇飞机巡航航程估算：R=(V·L/D/g)·ln(Wi/Wf)。: Cruise range estimate for turbojet/turbofan aircraft: R=(V·L/D/g)·ln(Wi/Wf).

map.已知航程目标，反推需要的燃油分数与起飞重量。: Given a range target, back-calculate the required fuel fraction and takeoff weight.
map.巡航速度 V=250 m/s、升阻比 L/D=18、起飞重量 Wi=600000: Cruise speed V=250 m/s, L/D=18, takeoff weight Wi=600000 N and landing weight Wf=500000 N. R=(250×18/9.81)×ln(600000/500000)=458.7×ln(1.2)≈458.7×0.1823≈83.6 (illustrative; note the unit should give metres, and this example uses a low L/D=18, so the result is illustrative). In practice use the real L/D and weights.
map.布雷盖公式的假设是什么？: What are the assumptions of the Breguet formula?
map.假设定常巡航、速度/升阻比近似不变、燃油消耗正比推力。对涡扇巡航很准；对螺旋桨或: It assumes steady cruise, approximately constant speed and L/D and fuel consumption proportional to thrust. It is quite accurate for turbofan cruise; for propeller or large speed-change segments it must be applied piecewise. The ln(Wi/Wf) term captures the cumulative effect of getting lighter and more efficient as it flies.
map.为什么升阻比影响这么大？: Why does the lift-to-drag ratio matter so much?
map.航程与 L/D 成正比。L/D 从 15 提到 20（减阻 25%），航程同比例: Range is proportional to L/D. Raising L/D from 15 to 20 (a 25% drag reduction) increases range proportionally, which is why airfoil/wetted-area drag reduction is highly valued.
